final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(1.0 * a / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS player_average FROM fielding_postseason GROUP BY player_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_average) AS overall_average FROM player_averages) SELECT AVG(p.player_average) AS average_player_average, AVG(p.player_average - o.overall_average) AS average_difference FROM player_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.player_average > o.overall_average
